authority.scope: W09-owned D1-03 push routing state; W05/T14 is a narrowly delegated self-service writer only, not a general D1-03 entity owner.

scopedWriter.scope: Self-service registration/deletion for the current user's Expo endpoint only.

constraints: installation_id is unique and represents an app installation identifier, not a trusted device identity.
provider + push_token is unique when push_token is present.
permissionStatus=granted requires a token; denied/undetermined requires a null token.
owner_user_id is derived from the W01-authenticated W02 principal and is never accepted in request data.
No cross-D1 foreign key to identity/session/account records is permitted.
indexes: uq_notification_push_endpoints_provider_token UNIQUE (provider, push_token) WHERE push_token IS NOT NULL

apiOperations.semantics: Idempotent upsert; repeated registration for the same installation replaces token/permission/platform/app-version state.
Idempotent owner-scoped deletion; does not revoke an authentication session or trusted device.

security.caller: W01 only through authenticated W02 session resolution
security.rateLimit: W01 origin/IP write limit plus W05 global and authenticated-principal limit
security.deliveryRead: Only W05 internal delivery runtime may read tokens under the separate notification-delivery contract.

nonGoals: No Expo Push API sending in this module.
No W10 Workflow or Queue behavior in this module.
No new Worker, D1 database, Queue, public direct Worker route, or Service Binding.
evidenceRequired: W05 D1-03 scoped binding and exact Worker source SHA
Remote migration ledger entry and D1-03 schema/index readback
W05 registration and owner-scoped deletion runtime tests
Negative tests for caller spoofing, token collision, denied permission, missing D1-03 binding, and unauthorized deletion
Production Expo push-token privacy and authorization E2E
